Here’s the latest update:

_**First**_ , on Friday afternoon, we secured an important win: a federal judge granted a preliminary injunction in our case that continues blocking the U.S. Postal Service from implementing its drastic and unlawful changes to mail voting through the November elections.

_**Then**_ , the Trump administration asked the U.S. Supreme Court, yet again, to intervene and allow the President’s mail-in voting restrictions to move forward.

_**Now**_ , we’re all waiting to see what comes next from the Supreme Court. You can be sure that my office is firmly committed to protecting the integrity of California’s elections.

**I will never stand by and let your fundamental right to vote be undermined or restricted — in this case, by a power-hungry President whose attempts at election interference are fueled by his own fears of losing the midterms. **

|

Speaker Mike Johnson is in the fight of his life – because Donald Trump demanded he debase himself and screw over his voters and literally every working person in America.
Johnson has accomplished almost nothing during his time as Speaker of the House. But one thing he did do was slash taxes for the top 1%: the private equity and Wall Street bigshots, tech elites and billionaires who are pillaging our communities with toxic AI data centers.
To pay for all that, they made massive cuts to Medicaid, Medicare, and assistance to rural folks and working families who need SNAP or WIC to survive. **
****Now, like Trump, Johnson knows the only way that Republicans survive the midterm election is to lie, cheat, and steal their way back to power.** And that all hinges on passing Trump’s boondoggle voter suppression bill, the so-called SAVE America Act, that would disenfranchise millions of voters overnight.

|
---
| [ ](https://jjajxo.clicks.mlsend2.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyODY4MDcsXCJsXCI6MTk4MTc5MzA3NzI0NDc0MTA3LFwiclwiOjE5ODE3OTMzMjUxMzg1OTIzOX0iLCJzIjoiNmI5ZDU0MmRlZWFmZmI5YyJ9)
---
|
---
Johnson spent the final weeks before the House left town for a month-long vacation aptly called “recess” attaching provisions of the SAVE Act to every single piece of legislation, including bills about defense spending.
No votes on any bills to lower costs for all of us. No votes to demand an end to Trump’s disastrous Iran war. No votes to save farmers like me from bankruptcy. Just voter suppression legislation to save his own hide in November.
These are the desperate acts of a desperate, pathetic man. **And it will be his downfall this November—**** _because I am going to give Mike Johnson the electoral thrashing he deserves._**
My name is Conrad Cable. I am a lifelong Democrat and a proud Louisiana farmer.
Mike Johnson has never faced a real challenge before in his entire political career. **Until now.** **[To finally get rid of Mike Johnson, we need Democrats from across the nation standing with us. Please send in a contribution of $25, $10, or even just $5 to help me send Speaker Johnson to an early retirement and take back the House for Democrats this November:](https://jjajxo.clicks.mlsend2.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyODY4MDcsXCJsXCI6MTk4MTc5MzA3NzMwNzY1NTY2LFwiclwiOjE5ODE3OTMzMjUxMzg1OTIzOX0iLCJzIjoiOWY2YmMwNDdmYTYzMDIyNCJ9)**

Hi, it’s Jon Ossoff. I’m the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won. And this U.S. Senate race in Georgia will be the most competitive and most expensive in the nation. So if you’re upset by what’s being done to our country right now and you’re ready to fight back, please chip in what you can to support my campaign here in Georgia. **Here’s the link to donate:**[**https://act.electjon.com/go/donate**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-sep26.MEWcSy&refcode=em260909-1-rs-b-f&utm_campaign=em260909-1-rs-b-f&t=3&akid=2840%2E5691347%2EMbGVSv) Otherwise, let me remind you why I ran for the Senate — and why this moment is even more urgent. Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution. More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminded me of those places where dissent was silenced by intimidation. Trump’s rise wasn’t just a crisis. It was a warning. I ran for Senate because I saw the danger in electing someone so profoundly unfit for the presidency and I wanted to confront the corruption that made his rise possible. We defeated him, and I won. But now returned to power, this President is staging a power grab unprecedented in our history:
* He’s freed violent criminals who attacked the Capitol on his behalf.
* Stacked key agencies with loyalists — and called on them to investigate his political opponents.
* Threatened to take news broadcasters off the air unless they met his demands for more favorable news coverage.
* And even called for elected Democrats to be EXECUTED.

**This is not a drill and it’s not a bad dream. As citizens, it is the test of our lifetimes.** In 2020, the pundits said flipping a Republican Senate seat in Georgia couldn’t be done. But we built one of the strongest voter mobilization programs in Senate campaign history — and _we won._ That victory won the Senate majority. Now we must win again. And _we will win again._ Just like last time, I can’t do it alone. So I’m asking: [**Please make a contribution to my reelection campaign today, of $10 or any amount that works for you.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-sep26.MEWcSy&refcode=em260909-1-rs-b-f&utm_campaign=em260909-1-rs-b-f&t=4&akid=2840%2E5691347%2EMbGVSv) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_ | | **[CONTRIBUTE $5](https://act.electjon.com/go/5967?c0=ossoff-em-sep26.P8PkJG&refcode=em260909-1-rs-b-f&utm_campaign=em260909-1-rs-b-f&t=23&akid=2840%2E5691347%2EMbGVSv)**

body:
Last night, the last primary election in a state that Swing Left is targeting this November concluded.
#
Hi there,
Last night's election was the final primary for Swing Left target races. Here’s a breakdown of what happened in New Hampshire:
* * *
**Senate**
Following Democratic Senator Jeanne Shaheen’s retirement, Democrats are fighting to keep this critical battleground seat blue.
In the Democratic Primary, **Chris Pappas** won the nomination. As a small business owner and the current representative for New Hampshire’s 1st Congressional District, Pappas has built a strong reputation of fighting for working people and delivering results. Currently representing a battleground district, he also has experience winning close races, which will be critical this November.
In the general election, Pappas will be facing **John E. Sununu** , a Republican who was first elected to represent New Hampshire nearly 30 years ago. While in Washington, he has consistently put the interests of Wall Street, Big Oil, and Big Pharma ahead of working families. As a former Senator, Sununu has won statewide races in New Hampshire before, so it’s critical that we leave nothing on the table as we work to defeat him and elect Chris Pappas this November.
**Democrats have a real shot at flipping the Senate this year, but it’s going to require holding every seat they currently have—including here in New Hampshire.**
That’s why the Swing Left community will be doing everything we can to help Chris win, including through Ground Truth, our innovative, volunteer-led deep canvassing program that aims to reach and turn out voters across the state.
[**Right now, the best way to support Chris Pappas is by donating directly to his campaign through Swing Left so that he can reach as many voters as possible before November.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=sl-senate-nh-2026.WioEtp&refcode=em20260909-2728&t=1&akid=2728%2E1562180%2E0jQdwE)
* * *
**State Legislature**
Last night’s primary also produced Democratic nominees for state legislative races—and while we’re not targeting any specific downballot seats, we will be working to flip the State House and break the Republican supermajority in the State Senate by fundraising for the New Hampshire House and Senate Caucuses.
New Hampshire’s legislature is the largest in the country, and control of the State House often follows national trends. Democrats last won a majority in the State House in the 2018 blue wave, and are positioned to do so again in this year’s midterms.
In the State Senate, Republicans currently control 16 of the 24 seats—but Democrats have a real opportunity to pick up seats and break the GOP supermajority in the chamber.
By breaking the supermajority in the State Senate and flipping the State House, we can break the GOP trifecta in New Hampshire and ensure Democrats have the power to stop Republican bills cracking down on voting rights in one of the nation’s most pivotal presidential and Senate swing states.
[**If you’d like to support Democrats running in legislative races across New Hampshire, click here to donate to the New Hampshire Win In The States Fund today.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2350?refcode=em20260909-2728&t=2&akid=2728%2E1562180%2E0jQdwE)
* * *
In both the Senate and House legislative races, winning in New Hampshire will not be easy. This state regularly elects officials from both parties, with a Republican currently holding the governor’s office.
We expect these races to be close. Support from the Swing Left community has the potential to make a powerful difference for Democrats this November.
Thank you, as always, for everything you do, and stay tuned for more updates soon!
— The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20260909-1&t=3&refcode2=2728_1562180_0jQdwE&akid=2728%2E1562180%2E0jQdwE)

Peter, I just walked off the stage in Dallas, and I'm writing you before I've even gotten my jacket off, because I want you to have the number I gave that room.

** 24 percent. **

That's the tax hike the average taxpayer in this country takes if we go backwards.

It isn't abstract and it isn't a talking point. It's a $1,400 tax cut for the average working family - **GONE.** The child tax credit cut in half, the money parents use for food and clothes and school supplies. The small business deduction that grows jobs at home, gone. The Trump accounts meant to give our kids a real shot, gone.

__[_**I told that room we already got a preview of what the other side is selling. I called it the Biden Burden: a wide open, lawless border. Men in women's sports. And a recession they lied to us about.**_](http://links.mikebouchardforcongress.com/u/click?_t=bb25c0b583c5471786d790f5e4203cc0&_m=22405e2c6d9e41a08f2fac7ca3945ef8&_e=MdC8ADmn8eo4BWV4fWeCi1Babh0OjfSG3VM_wyhOJpzb4y5nod1GCL7-68kitX0Kn88iL1xs35J0xTPWBXceVg098QupIpSkS5yAwKHGBTe3weyNXFDzxEJzbPT19EHrxQLNq_4bfGbtV_ww2gpaKyqCoreKnljFjBXCjGr3bu-NQy8cWxfvnXK5kMFZa07ZkG3EZ8Ht7uXXbSln10zmT_tKVKNM3a2xUoyeNcLS10taJlWts-9I8DfHxqb-VuLseRkYRdAFSJOK0UCKY43lyoIQwYAVgiRavGkI37-LET2biRM5vWh1FBDrIyBo9wxfYNbcpgRA8S15uMQwIOKQbXhu0pew7OwTRRvXhfJXP6zhpFQ0m9ZEIRE14lQ8L0XRRF1XR7lxXSlTBBtlZnQv6n8dZGdIHS881f3cE5ZsjEQ10hWiHPmxao1q1fG_-obDpl9eIlLY_0PHeIOqxSiexOMFvWLyDbNU476HDZnzD8vxI6__diCgBQGaAlibKSFSYQ8Sz2w0HC7qRq-TqIHLAlk_metbmsQ0oVYkNxhA_aQwHZAEa5-s8L-qKKDjv0XG)
But I didn't walk out under those lights just to defend. I told them what I'm fighting to advance - no tax on tips, no tax on overtime, child tax credits, tax credits for K-12 scholarships, lower taxes on Social Security, a closed and secure border, and most favored nation drug pricing that brought prescription costs to their lowest point in sixty years.

**They want the Biden Burden back.**

_**We say no.**_

I served over a decade in the Army because I believe this is still the greatest country on the planet. I came home from that deployment with one mission: make life easier for every mom, dad, street cop, veteran, teacher, and autoworker I represent.

__[_That mission doesn't run on applause. It runs on people like you._](http://links.mikebouchardforcongress.com/u/click?_t=bb25c0b583c5471786d790f5e4203cc0&_m=22405e2c6d9e41a08f2fac7ca3945ef8&_e=MdC8ADmn8eo4BWV4fWeCi1Babh0OjfSG3VM_wyhOJpzb4y5nod1GCL7-68kitX0Kn88iL1xs35J0xTPWBXceVg098QupIpSkS5yAwKHGBTe3weyNXFDzxEJzbPT19EHrxQLNq_4bfGbtV_ww2gpaKyqCoreKnljFjBXCjGr3bu-NQy8cWxfvnXK5kMFZa07ZkG3EZ8Ht7uXXbSln10zmT3NdG6zpyymoCxSMCmhFI6B4m7He_oOtpY6BywN3i7yHyZe2feHnXAIRymZ_p0NzyRzQwJLB9qpDwmk5QFHhC4CayTPOq7UI8TTiNnUt11H_ZRdW0ZOjzRsbJsGe803BahbIQ8cqyicqM2VIRY6e42pv8OcMW1qzBT8pVD9_LlXKW889lafwdNG6MWr0cPApBjBcuxMp7qFo0JqsIHfPuKk2ZOhV2Z01c8wLYep-MiFbTrZhwu2feJf85i22AE3GKBdMgV5V2QUbXtBCd0wLP_BYIJCOxSqZhZBnU5h_dUmtkfPCQV5XzSH09vIetViN_Z8XCORyKKxIsnQmyndxnapmUylNo9dXPoJ2qC5Wg1TI)
And it runs on a clock.**Three weeks from tonight is the September 30 reporting deadline - the number every committee reads to decide which seats are worth defending.** If this one comes in weak, they walk away from it. If it comes in strong, they stand by our sides and fight with us.

Let’s do this!

Hi friends,
We're less than two months out from the midterm elections, and I wanted to take a minute to explain what's happening this week.
Republicans are gathering in Dallas for their first-ever midterm convention. Trump and Vance are both speaking, and the GOP is hoping to leverage these two days to fire up their base and their megadonors ahead of November.
The GOP thinks this rally is going to give them the boost they need to overcome Democratic enthusiasm. We need to prove them wrong.
**What are we up against?**
Elon Musk has said he's putting upwards of $100 million behind Republican Senate candidates this cycle. When the world's first trillionaire starts writing checks like that, it's worth asking what it means. And now _The New York Times_ just reported Trump's super PAC MAGA Inc. is dumping $47 million into battleground Senate races.
Here's how I see it: This convention - and this kind of spending - isn't a sign of confidence. These are signs that Republicans know their chances of holding onto their Senate majority are much slimmer than anyone expected not too long ago.
**Why does this matter right now?**
Democrats' chances of flipping the Senate since Trump took office again have never been better, and the analysts are catching up to what we've felt on the ground for months. _The New York Times_ recently described the Senate as "up for grabs." Election forecasters who once wrote off Democrats' chances - including Nate Silver - are now calling it a "toss-up."
Voters are frustrated with the cost of living and with Trump's chaotic handling of, well, almost everything - and that frustration is opening doors in races Republicans used to consider safe.
**We need to flip four seats to win back the majority. Four. And with your support, we can get it done.**
Republicans have Elon Musk and their special interest megadonors, but Democrats have something better: YOU. And we have the opportunity to turn this week into a source of grassroots momentum and energy - sending a message to the media, to volunteers and organizers, and to voters across this country that Democrats have what it takes to flip the Senate blue.
**While Republicans have their big, loud party in Dallas, we 're building a solid, dependable grassroots team. Let's come together to make these two days about something the GOP couldn't anticipate: a counter show of strength from this team.**
**[If you're in a position to help Democrats take back the Senate, I hope you'll pitch in before Trump gives his closing remarks tomorrow night. Every dollar adds up to real momentum heading into November.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c6366f3e-b3e8-4636-a184-5a4c761dbad4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Thanks for all you do,
Jacky
* * *
##### `A personal note from Sen. Jacky Rosen:`
##### `My work in the Senate has always been defined by who I am and where I come from. Growing up as the granddaughter of immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran, my family instilled in me the values of hard work, determination, and persistence at a young age.`
##### `Now, I'm proud to fight tirelessly in the Senate to deliver progress for hardworking families like mine in Nevada and across our country. But with Donald Trump in the White House and Republicans in control of both houses of Congress, I need your grassroots support to keep up the fights that matter most.`
##### `Senate Democrats like me are the only thing standing in the way of Trump's extreme agenda that will hurt everyday Americans. That's why I need people like you on my side to help defend our progress and reclaim power from the GOP.`
##### `If you're with me, will you chip in now to help Democrats take back the Senate majority?`

The lobbyists who have kept housing out of reach, energy bills climbing, and health care too expensive for working Mainers. They've spent years betting on themselves, and they'd love nothing more than to point at this independent campaign and whisper: _"Not real. Can't win. No money."_ This is our shot to answer them loudly, and together. Every contribution that lands before midnight on September 15 becomes part of the final number Maine sees before we vote. And that number tells this state exactly two things:
* That this movement is real.
* That it's **powered by Mainers, not by millionaires.**

I am not running a campaign of the party bosses. I'm running a campaign that answers only to the people of Maine. I am focused on lowering costs with real solutions, and relentlessly working for results. That's not a slogan. That's the whole point of this race. Here's exactly what your gift does before the deadline:
* **$25** keeps this grassroots coalition growing
* **$50** helps us put our message in front of 2,000 more Mainers by text
* **$100** reaches roughly 4,000 voters with our affordability message
* **$250** carries this campaign to 100,000 Mainers across social media
* **$500+** helps us scale our digital program to the 225,000 voters we need to win

Maine has never needed the machines to do great things. The most important chapters in our history were written by ordinary people who refused to be told it couldn't be done. **Let's write our own chapter together before the deadline.**

I recently had the opportunity to meet with a large group of seniors at a senior living facility in Stamford. The group was interested in what I had to say regarding the future of Social Security, Socialism, Medicare for all, the effects of high energy prices on the Connecticut economy and the need for college students to know before they start what the job prospects were for the field they planned to major in. There is also a need for expansion of Trade Schools. I have attached the video of the speech so that you can learn more of the details and later see the Q&A.
The type of questions asked, and their expected responses ran the gamut of the political spectrum from the most liberal, moderate and conservative.
Thanks for reading The Goldstein Substack! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..eyph_ZqLi8D1WESRqKOG75NvRYhGOiGCOCZfkRCXr5I?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=214969967)
From listening to the questions from apparent liberals, I found that their analysis of the facts was in part based on misinformation and sometimes the unwillingness to accept the facts.
Those on the more liberal side were obsessed with ICE and the mistreatment of Illegals. Even when I told them that President Obama deported Illegals at double the rate of President Trump that did not matter. Even when I told them that President Obama raided factories that also did not matter. Apparently, the media that they follow has so shaped their thinking that it does not change even when presented with hard evidence that their ideas were based on misinformation, I could not change their minds.
Some of them were also obsessed with the 2020 election and their anger about President Trump's claim that the election was rigged. I told them that you could not change the past and that Biden was president for four years and he was gone. I told them that it is the future that counts. They were adamant that there was no election fraud. I told them that I has seen irregularities in Bridgeport and that I believed that there was election fraud and that fraudulent elections compromise out democracy.
Another absurd comment was that President Trump was a Fascist and responsible for the antisemitism in this country. I told them that this was an absurd idea and that all of the violent antisemitism taking place on college campuses was happening on university campuses controlled by liberals. I also talked about the antisemitism in New York controlled by the Islamic Jihadist Zohran Mamdani who was a Communist. What I failed to mention was that when President Trump threatened to and withheld funds from universities that violated the civil rights of Jews. As a result of this economic pressure many universities changed their policies but not Harvard. In fact Jim Himes came to the defense of Harvard and stated that just because Harvard was in violation of the Civil Rights Act that was no reason to withhold funds. That view is disturbing because in my opinion any institution that flagrantly violates the Civil Rights Act should not be subsidized with taxpayer money.
These were the most disturbing of the comments I encountered. These seniors are intelligent and they seem to do their best to be informed about what is going on in our country. Unfortunately, they are the victims of a misinformation campaign that is being propagated by many mainstream media outlets both on television and in print. While many younger voters have left the mainstream media for other information sources the seniors are more likely to continue to rely on the mainstream media.
I believe in freedom of the press, but I find when the press which is supposed to report the facts but instead becomes a propaganda arm of the liberal left establishment, it is hijacking of the press. If the media is presenting opinion rather than news, then in all fairness, they should air dissenting opinions.
There were many intelligent and thoughtful questions that I did my best to answer. There are certainly valid concerns regarding the future of Social Security. One member of the audience expressed valid distrust for politicians to competently manage a $2.5 trillion dollar Social Security Trust Fund. I do agree that these are valid concerns. Unless we can increase the rate of return on the Social Security Trust fund then the only ways to keep the system solvent are some combination of raising the wage limit subject to Social Security Tax and or raising the retirement age. These are both hard choices;
I found it was very worthwhile to meet and engage with the entire spectrum of senior voters. I did get the feeling that some of the more liberal voters liked me as a person but would vote according to their ideological beliefs.
As the campaign continues, II am looking forward to meeting more groups of voters. If you belong to an organization that would meet with me and discuss issues please reach out.

Now looky here, Peter:
**Democrats have a snowball’s chance in hell of retaking the U.S. Senate majority this fall without flipping North Carolina’s red seat blue.**
Ain’t nobody’s done that since 2008, and right now, the GOP is flooding _beaucoup bucks_ into NC to keep it that way. That’s ‘cause having a proven winner like two-term former Governor Roy Cooper as the Democratic nominee is our best chance of flipping _any_ of the four seats we need.
Roy can’t overcome the full force of the GOP’s dark-money machine on his own, [**_so if you’re my kind of Democrat – the kind who believes our #1 mission is to take back the Senate from Trump’s far-right flunkies – then I’mma need you to get off your derrière and pitch in $5 or more to his grassroots campaign ASAP._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1472&amount=5&t=9&akid=3359%2E124072%2EfV5DqG)
Now you'll have to pardon my French, but I'm scared sh*tless Democrats just don't get how bad we need to fight for North Carolina this year.
Every election since 2008, the polls and expert ratings had us convinced NC was going our way ... only for some milquetoast Republican jackass to beat us by a few points on Election Day.
And believe me: **The jack*ss Roy’s up against this November has _a lot_ going his way.**
His GOP opponent Michael Whatley is the former chair of the RNC, so big-time Republicans like the President and my evil twin Steven Miller are putting their thumbs on the scales in his favor.
On top of that, their super PACs are spending just shy of _$100 million_ so far on baseless attack ads against Roy – **and now, a recent poll shows his slim lead SHRINKING. This race is officially a statistically tied ballgame.**
Without the grassroots resources to surge ahead and reach every last voter between the Outer Banks and the Smokies, Roy could lose this race – and Democrats can say goodbye to flipping the Senate!!!
[**_If you want to stop that from happening, then PLEASE, Peter, before midnight, rush $5 or anything you can spare – toot sweet – to ensure Roy has the grassroots funds to fight back and win in North Carolina. The future of our country depends on it._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1472&amount=5&t=10&akid=3359%2E124072%2EfV5DqG)

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138899670/645581688/1424706884?&refcode=E31550-20260909-MaryPeltola-Image-Surrogate&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk4MjcyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg3M2NkMTI2LWIzYWMtZjExMS05YjMzLTAwMjI0ODJhOTMzYiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=JomAc5HpLRbuAjRpyaMlbvnP5yO5TrP7kNjp5cFBZj4=) They’re joining every other major election forecaster in recognizing that the momentum is on our side. They know what we know: **We are going to win this race.** Alaskans are ready for change. I’ve spent the past nine months traveling to communities in every corner of the state – from Prince of Wales to St. Lawrence Island, the Kenai to the Arctic. And everywhere I go, I hear the same thing: _Enough._ Enough of Dan Sullivan’s self-dealing. He’s _tripled_ his personal wealth since getting to DC, and Alaskans are paying the price. We are getting crushed by corporate greed while he turns the other way, and we’re tired of it. I’m angry that the millionaires and billionaires have rigged the system in DC against working Alaskans. I’m angry that it doesn’t work for us anymore. But I’m also optimistic. Alaskans are can-do people. And together, on November 3rd, we’re going to take the first step toward taking back our state. We won nearly 50% of the vote in our open primary election last month, against 15 other candidates of all parties – including incumbent Senator Dan Sullivan. More than 82,000 Alaskans cast their ballots in favor of our fish, family, freedom campaign for a more abundant Alaska. Peter,

Our general election is underway, and _a lot_ has been happening. Outside money is flooding in. The attacks keep coming. And you've been with me every step of the way.

So I want to take a step back from all that — and remind you why I got in this race to begin with. **[If you already know you're with us, you can chip in $3 right now and I'll see you on the other side. If you've got a minute, I'd love to tell you my story.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138899826/645589601/1981932151?refcode=em-9.9.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNmM1NzNkMGYtYjZhYy1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAyMjQ4MmE5MzNiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=iT5rJn5RVU9fooMWLxqws2gzzQ_O__u3RSwjzniPV0Y=)**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138899827/645589602/1981932151?refcode=em-9.9.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNmM1NzNkMGYtYjZhYy1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAyMjQ4MmE5MzNiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=iT5rJn5RVU9fooMWLxqws2gzzQ_O__u3RSwjzniPV0Y=)
_Back in the day at Palla Elementary School in Bakersfield (Go Bulldogs!)_
I grew up in Bakersfield, the son of Mexican immigrants. My dad opened an auto shop here in 2006. My mom was a homemaker. We didn't have much — I shared a bunk bed in the living room with my brothers. On weekends, I worked at the swap meet and helped out at the shop.

Nobody in my family had ever gone to college. I was the first.

I watched my parents work themselves to the bone in a Valley that wasn’t built for families like ours. I watched my older brother navigate life as a DACA recipient, always one policy change away from losing everything. I proudly saw my younger brother put on a uniform to serve our country as a Marine.

The Central Valley made me who I am. And for a long time, I thought the best way I could give back was to teach. So I became a professor at College of the Sequoias and a school board trustee -- making sure kids in this Valley had more doors open to them than I did.

But something kept nagging at me.

CA-22 has been represented by David Valadao for years. He looked Central Valley families in the eye and promised us he would never cut Medicaid — which is a lifeline for hundreds of thousands of our neighbors. Then he voted for Trump's budget and did exactly that.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138899828/645589603/1981932151?refcode=em-9.9.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNmM1NzNkMGYtYjZhYy1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAyMjQ4MmE5MzNiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=iT5rJn5RVU9fooMWLxqws2gzzQ_O__u3RSwjzniPV0Y=)
I was at those rallies with the nurses, farmworkers, and ordinary working families who couldn't believe their representative had sold them out. And I kept thinking: someone has to run against him. Someone who actually knows what it means to need Medicaid. Someone who grew up and built a life here.

So I got in. Not because I wanted to be something, but because I wanted to _do something_ \-- for the families who can't afford to see a doctor, for the parents who can't afford rent, for the kids growing up in a Valley with dirty air, broken promises and no one in Washington fighting for them.

And with your support, we’re going to win.

**[Corporate PACs and special interests are propping up Valadao's campaign, and they're not going anywhere between now and November. We need to keep our message in front of voters. Can you chip in $3 to help us finish what we started?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138899829/645589604/1981932151?refcode=em-9.9.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNmM1NzNkMGYtYjZhYy1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAyMjQ4MmE5MzNiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=iT5rJn5RVU9fooMWLxqws2gzzQ_O__u3RSwjzniPV0Y=)**

clean_body: | = Peter, Our general election is underway, and a lot has been happening. Outside money is flooding in. The attacks keep coming. And you've been with me every step of the way. So I want to take a step back from all that — and remind you why I got in this race to begin with. = = Back in the day at Palla Elementary School in Bakersfield (Go Bulldogs!) I grew up in Bakersfield, the son of Mexican immigrants. My dad opened an auto shop here in 2006. My mom was a homemaker. We didn't have much — I shared a bunk bed in the living room with my brothers. On weekends, I worked at the swap meet and helped out at the shop. Nobody in my family had ever gone to college. I was the first. I watched my parents work themselves to the bone in a Valley that wasn’t built for families like ours. I watched my older brother navigate life as a DACA recipient, always one policy change away from losing everything. I proudly saw my younger brother put on a uniform to serve our country as a Marine. The Central Valley made me who I am. And for a long time, I thought the best way I could give back was to teach. So I became a professor at College of the Sequoias and a school board trustee -- making sure kids in this Valley had more doors open to them than I did. But something kept nagging at me. CA-22 has been represented by David Valadao for years. He looked Central Valley families in the eye and promised us he would never cut Medicaid — which is a lifeline for hundreds of thousands of our neighbors. Then he voted for Trump's budget and did exactly that. = I was at those rallies with the nurses, farmworkers, and ordinary working families who couldn't believe their representative had sold them out. And I kept thinking: someone has to run against him. Someone who actually knows what it means to need Medicaid. Someone who grew up and built a life here. So I got in. Not because I wanted to be something, but because I wanted to do something \-- for the families who can't afford to see a doctor, for the parents who can't afford rent, for the kids growing up in a Valley with dirty air, broken promises and no one in Washington fighting for them. # 72 hours from Baltimore City to Montgomery and Prince George's Counties...for a Strong Maryland.
Dear friend,
We are traveling back from a speaking engagement in Baltimore County just now, and in the last 72+ hours we've had events and tours of Baltimore City & County, Prince George's and Montgomery County.

[](https://us.list-manage.com/YbLadxquyKP?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)

In Baltimore City among other stops, Rob Krop and I and our team visited where a 74 year old man, Steven King, was jumped by a gang of six young men outside a 7-Eleven, one carrying a rifle and another a sword, during which time they knocked him down, kicked and beat him, and severely injured him including fractured ribs, damaged hand, and severe bodily bruising.

_After six weeks, there have still been no arrests made for this violent assault with deadly weapons here in Wes Moore's Maryland_. It's not the Maryland the local residents want. And it is not the Maryland we know. With your help we will win and bring needed immediate change and relief to our state.

**CABLE TV UPDATE!**
We just received our Cable TV proposal and while it is exciting to plan the purchase, we need to raise additional immediate funds to get our ads rolling. The rates include up to $24,000 for a 30 second ad during prime time (Ravens Game), and anywhere from $200 to $2500 for main programming.

Will you sponsor a TV ad? [$250 for one spot during news;](https://us.list-manage.com/12rSs9pnkG3?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) [$1000 for one spot during college football; $2500 for one spot during prime college football games or Face the Nation or similar programming](https://us.list-manage.com/MwQxnP9gd8c?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b). Help us secure those spots today.

Also, we have a quote for [$1000 ](https://us.list-manage.com/FQNOLBC78V0?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)per billboard for a month for certain spots, more for other locations. Help us target [one, two, three or even six ](https://us.list-manage.com/SH_qSVVXYWl?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)billboards tonight.

Thank you for your support. Wes Moore is vulnerable and we will beat him with your help. He is underwater politically with 42% disapproval and 48% approval. Over 131,000 Marylanders have chosen NO MOORE in their voter registrations in just the seven "blue" counties we are working hard in.

We only have two weeks until the first mail-in balloting goes out, 42 days until Early Voting begins, and 54 days until Election Day. Now is the moment we must purchase and secure these ad times.

Thank you for your standing with us. If you have already donated, thank you. Would you consider doubling your prior donation to launch us into the final fifty days? This is it, there is no future Maryland without you.

For Maryland,
[](https://us.list-manage.com/Wl6H7zSBJf0?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)
Dan Cox
Republican nominee for Governor

subject: 55 days. Read this right now.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
The primary is behind us. What happens in the next eight weeks determines everything.
It's James Carville.
The primary is over. The match-up is set. And John Sununu and his Republican allies are watching Chris Pappas’s campaign right now — looking for any sign of weakness, any hesitation, any gap in resources they can exploit.
I’ve been around long enough to know what happens next: If they see it, they flood this state with money. If they don’t, they think twice.
_What they see in the next few days matters tremendously._
**[Rush a contribution to Chris Pappas right now. The general election has started, and we cannot afford to blink first.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260909_4.zcLwy_&refcode=em20260909-4&t=1&akid=8833%2E582294%2ECVAUri)**
Let me be plain about the stakes. There is no path to winning back the Senate majority without winning New Hampshire. **None.**
If Chris Pappas loses this seat, Democrats need to flip five seats instead of four. That math doesn’t work.
John Sununu has more than $30 million in Republican outside spending flooding into the state and more coming. He’s got the name, the money, and the GOP machine that has decided New Hampshire is their best shot at the Senate. They are not letting up for a single day.
Chris Pappas has won the toughest district in New Hampshire four damn times. He knows how to reach voters across the aisle and win. But he cannot — _cannot_ — go into the general election flat-footed on resources while Sununu’s allies are already flooding the airwaves.
So here’s what I need from you right now:
**[Rush a contribution to Chris Pappas today. $10, $25, whatever you can spare. Because the signal we send in the first few days of the general election tells the GOP everything they need to know about whether we’re ready for this fight.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260909_4.zcLwy_&refcode=em20260909-4&t=2&akid=8833%2E582294%2ECVAUri)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260909_4.zcLwy_&amount=5&refcode=em20260909-4&t=21&akid=8833%2E582294%2ECVAUri)**
I’ve seen races won and lost in moments exactly like this one. The campaigns that respond to the start of a general election with strength go on the offensive. The ones that hesitate get buried.
We are not hesitating.
**[Give what you can right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260909_4.zcLwy_&refcode=em20260909-4&t=22&akid=8833%2E582294%2ECVAUri)** Let’s win this damn thing and flip control of the Senate.
— James Carville

**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**

**CONCORD, N.H. —** Today, Delegates and Guests of the New Hampshire Republican Party attended Night 1 of the RNC Convention in Dallas, Texas. New Hampshire Republican State Committee Chairman Scott Maltzie released the following statement:

“We heard from some amazing leaders in the party who got attendees excited about our country’s future and the midterm elections,” said NHGOP Chairman Scott Maltzie. “Their speeches highlighted the Republican agenda and the ways the administration and Congress are working to help Americans build a more prosperous future. Our attendees are energized and ready to bring that momentum back to New Hampshire.”

“President Trump spoke about the everyday American. His historic Working Families Tax Cuts delivered relief Americans needed. President Trump’s accomplishments, paired with the New Hampshire Advantage, has continued to make the lives of Granite Staters better.”

On October 1, I'm welcoming one my heroes to Pittsburgh. Father [Greg Boyle](https://substack.com/redirect/7eab33af-8005-4ea9-9bd6-992edbb9793d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is a Jesuit priest who founded Homeboy Industries when he was pastor of Dolores Mission in Los Angeles. Now they run multiple bakeries, tattoo removal businesses, and other social enterprises, serving tens of thousands of people each year. President Biden awarded him with the Medal of Freedom in 2024, our nation's highest civilian honor. Father Boyle will be the keynote speaker at the annual dinner for the Trade Institute of Pittsburgh, where I serve on the board. The dinner is in downtown Pittsburgh and there are still some seats remaining, which you can buy a ticket for (or just support us) [here](https://substack.com/redirect/8f9d13dd-0841-46c3-9e98-1fe602204055?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). (Last year I [interviewed](https://substack.com/redirect/4cfe2a87-a052-4b2c-afd4-113ef9449ba7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Trade Institute CEO, Donta Green, on this Substack for Giving Tuesday.)
That takes care of the invitation. The recommendation is that, in honor of 9/11, everyone read [this fantastic piece](https://substack.com/redirect/194e08e8-dc1e-429a-8974-8472018db721?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about the family of Kevin Dowdell, a firefighter who gave his life that day. He was "the man who refused to sit on the sidelines." It's nice to be reminded who Americans really are, at our best.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ec5cdcaa-07fd-42da-b97e-7de44ca75ae4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It's not an easy read (especially for the Irish Americans) but it's an important one. Excerpts below, full piece is gift linked [here](https://substack.com/redirect/194e08e8-dc1e-429a-8974-8472018db721?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Kevin Dowdell was handsome in a regular way, with dark-brown hair in an old-fashioned side-comb and a lean triangle of a face that tapered to a good chin. But he had some gravel in him, and his forearms were as thick as the fat end of a baseball bat. He was the grandson of an Irish longshoreman who'd left a dying fishing port in Fingal and arrived at Ellis Island in 1904 with $3 in his pocket. Kevin's father, a butcher, raised seven children on leftover baloney ends in an 1,100-square-foot rowhouse in Brooklyn. . . .
> The Dowdells moved to the Rockaways, known as the "Irish Riviera" for its enclaves of firefighters and cops, where the neighbors might swap shifts so you could spend time with your kids. Kevin found a small bungalow that wasn't winterized and renovated it with his own two hands. They were so poor that they couldn't afford a stove at first; instead, they cooked on a hot plate. When James came 17 months after Patrick, they put a second crib in the tiny nursery. . . .
> One of their few indulgences was Friday dinner in Greenwich Village . . . . "Put on something nice," Kevin would tell the boys. "Dress like your father has a job." He would order the veal parmigiana and a glass of red wine, look around the table at his family, and say, "This is what I work all week for." . . . .
> Over the years, Kevin worked so many "good" fires that he became something of a legend in the FDNY . . . . In 1991, Kevin helped keep flames at bay on the 12th floor of a Seventh Avenue building to aid a stunning rope rescue of two men from window ledges. In 1993, he was among the first responders to the terrorist bombing of the World Trade Center, which left a crater several stories deep and required him to comb through hazardous rubble, still glowing orange, while gas tanks exploded in the underground parking garages. In 1994, a gas leak blew up a diner in Long Island City, dropping the ground floor into the basement and pinning a waitress under slabs of concrete. Kevin and his partners crawled into the wreckage and worked for three hours to free her as piles of debris quaked over them. He took turns holding her hand and shielding her body with his own, in case the slabs caved. They got her out alive, and won medals for that job. In 1995, he was part of an elite FEMA squad deployed in the aftermath of the Oklahoma City bombing to search for survivors and recover bodies. . . .
> He was strict and exacting with his sons. For every minute they were late to something, Kevin docked them half an hour of free time. When they were old enough, he enlisted them in construction work, and didn't pay them until they could lift heavy loads. "You work like a man, you get paid like a man." He once called James home from a friend's house because he hadn't cleaned his room. He marched James into the doorway and said, "Look at that." There was a pair of socks on the floor.
> Patrick was growing into a burly achiever who aspired to West Point. James was slighter, milder, but with a distance runner's stamina. During long car rides in New York gridlock, Kevin would ask the boys what they intended to do with their lives. Their grandfather was a butcher. Their father was a fireman. "I want you to be the next step up from that," Kevin told them. "I want you to do something better than me." . . . .
> Kevin reported to Rescue 4 at 6 p.m. on the evening of September 10 for a 24-hour shift. . . . [The next day,] Rescue 4 arrived at a scene that was too much for the senses. A torrent of debris fell from the buildings--shredded metal and insulation, chunks of concrete, shivering glass shards--amid an earsplitting clamor of sirens and screaming. Torsos, luggage, and aluminum scraps of 767s were strewn on the sidewalks. What looked like splashes of red paint on the plazas were the remains of jumpers who had pinwheeled from the upper floors of the North Tower. Kevin ran into a stunned fellow lieutenant named Robert LaRocco, from Ladder 9, who had seen a severed forearm with a perfectly manicured hand. LaRocco managed to get a call through to his wife. He told her, "It's raining people."
> Kevin reported to a command post across the street from the North Tower, where the FDNY's chief of special operations command, Ray Downey, was doling out orders. He assigned Rescue 4 to help with evacuations in the South Tower and, if possible, to get upstairs and beat back the fire. Kevin was seen lining up his men and talking to them intently. He then led them single file toward the South Tower, hugging the sides of buildings. . . .

Patrick was growing into a burly achiever who aspired to West Point. James was slighter, milder, but with a distance runner's stamina. During long car rides in New York gridlock, Kevin would ask the boys what they intended to do with their lives. Their grandfather was a butcher. Their father was a fireman. "I want you to be the next step up from that," Kevin told them. "I want you to do something better than me." . . . . Kevin reported to Rescue 4 at 6 p.m. on the evening of September 10 for a 24-hour shift. . . . [The next day,] Rescue 4 arrived at a scene that was too much for the senses. A torrent of debris fell from the buildings--shredded metal and insulation, chunks of concrete, shivering glass shards--amid an earsplitting clamor of sirens and screaming. Torsos, luggage, and aluminum scraps of 767s were strewn on the sidewalks. What looked like splashes of red paint on the plazas were the remains of jumpers who had pinwheeled from the upper floors of the North Tower. Kevin ran into a stunned fellow lieutenant named Robert LaRocco, from Ladder 9, who had seen a severed forearm with a perfectly manicured hand. LaRocco managed to get a call through to his wife. He told her, "It's raining people." Kevin reported to a command post across the street from the North Tower, where the FDNY's chief of special operations command, Ray Downey, was doling out orders. He assigned Rescue 4 to help with evacuations in the South Tower and, if possible, to get upstairs and beat back the fire. Kevin was seen lining up his men and talking to them intently. He then led them single file toward the South Tower, hugging the sides of buildings. . . . You're currently a free subscriber to . ---
| Friend,
A little, it was revealed that the U.S. Postal Service is moving forward with a plan to limit mail-in voting by only sending ballots to voters who are registered on a list approved by the federal government. Now there is an even more alarming update:
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001cbAq0EX1QOLEhCSAoaAAcBPbSYaCqVgScktcqwzhcUp8U3IGMt1calrod-cNIduqcDxHPINy_tSl_DqMGU2RwIO2DoXDlXjtPVNJ73bpxK6zvcvp3Bri-2RvPfjCIXlQdTuSDdg_8RJb01jP96Ra7T-Fx79Ytrl5sTk_Q-foMCIjyKoMojEpcRcmBwy2804468Rx7484L3XHPVCAQsstLinWXuxS9ysyxPwRPyHzoAunIXiqG2o8LtC6g2Jm2dZuv3anx9IQXq-70OFomkvMsQ==&c=DB0r2ocgnCGsfRFR9uqch6T3DHm6eAKA1ijLh483jsuqWeWFD0nz6Q==&ch=ve6FITqYeHlrHV-PheFR5_ZGdEMVddVD2i3AvzEUxBdmbDYCF7lDvg==)
---
| Donald Trump is using the United States Postal Service to strong-arm Democratic states into surrendering their voter lists. The threat is simple: hand over the data, or your voters' ballots do not get delivered. And those lists contain the names and home addresses of every registered Democrat in those states.
We know exactly what MAGA does with voter data. In 2021, a dark money group called True the Vote challenged more than 364,000 Georgia voters just before the Senate runoff that handed Democrats the majority. Young voters and Black voters were twice as likely to be challenged, the same voters who flipped Georgia in 2020. A federal judge later ruled their data "utterly lacked credibility" and "verged on reckless."
But getting caught does not stop dark money operations, it just sends them shopping for better data. There is no better data than official government voter records and Trump is delivering it. In April, it was revealed the Trump admin is secretly funneling seized voter data to political groups with a track record of trying to overturn election results:
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001cbAq0EX1QOLEhCSAoaAAcBPbSYaCqVgScktcqwzhcUp8U3IGMt1calrod-cNIduqcDxHPINy_tSl_DqMGU2RwIO2DoXDlXjtPVNJ73bpxK6zvcvp3Bri-2RvPfjCIXlQdTuSDdg_8RJb01jP96Ra7T-Fx79Ytrl5sTk_Q-foMCIjyKoMojEpcRcmBwy2804468Rx7484L3XHPVCAQsstLinWXuxS9ysyxPwRPyHzoAunIXiqG2o8LtC6g2Jm2dZuAT2h6z_5ATwKEQKpnftI4g==&c=DB0r2ocgnCGsfRFR9uqch6T3DHm6eAKA1ijLh483jsuqWeWFD0nz6Q==&ch=ve6FITqYeHlrHV-PheFR5_ZGdEMVddVD2i3AvzEUxBdmbDYCF7lDvg==)
---
| The data pipeline is being established right now to rig the upcoming midterm elections. Trump uses the USPS to squeeze the states, the lists flow to dark money groups, and those groups mass-challenge Democratic voters off the rolls before the most important midterm of our lives.
Legal challenges to this rule are coming, and they will land right where MAGA wants them: The U.S. Supreme Court. We have all seen how this Court rules. They overturned Roe. They gutted the Voting Rights Act. They handed Trump criminal immunity. This court has been fully exposed as a puppet of Trump and MAGA extremists, willing to torch a half-century of precedent to tilt elections their way.
So ask yourself: do you trust this Supreme Court to stop Trump from weaponizing voter data against Democrats? Neither do we.
This is exactly why Defend Our Courts exists. We are fighting on two fronts. First, building a firewall of state Supreme Courts with the power to protect free and fair elections state by state. Second, building the movement to reform a federal Court that has made itself an arm of the Trump administration. [We need every Democrat who understands what is at stake to stand with us. Can we count on you to rush a donation of $50, $25, or whatever you can spare to help us fight for free and fair elections?](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001cbAq0EX1QOLEhCSAoaAAcBPbSYaCqVgScktcqwzhcUp8U3IGMt1calrod-cNIduqcDxHPINy_tSl_DqMGU2RwIO2DoXDlXjtPVNJ73bpxK6zvcvp3Bri-2RvPfjCIXlQdTuSDdg_8RJb01jP96Ra7T-Fx79Ytrl5sTk_Q-foMCIjyKoMojEpcRcmBwy2804468Rx7484L3XHPVCAQsstLinWXuxS9ysyxPwRPyHzoAunIXiqG2o8LtC6g2Jm2dZuscERirtqGA6ylkMfUCWpFA==&c=DB0r2ocgnCGsfRFR9uqch6T3DHm6eAKA1ijLh483jsuqWeWFD0nz6Q==&ch=ve6FITqYeHlrHV-PheFR5_ZGdEMVddVD2i3AvzEUxBdmbDYCF7lDvg==)

It's been four years since Russia invaded Ukraine, and by the fourth day of that war, many of us knew modern warfare had taken an evolutionary leap. The Russians should have been in Kyiv in three days, but their advance stalled and they were taking heavy casualties. The world was shocked. How did a small, relatively weak nation like Ukraine hold off one of the largest and best-equipped armies in the world?
Let's focus on two key points. First, after years of purging effective officers and administrators, Russia lacked the capacity to field a large army. Second, Ukraine demonstrated a brilliant grasp of asymmetric warfare. That's how an underdog fights to win. Ukraine used cheap drones, quick strikes, and clever deceptions to tie down the heavy, conventional Russian forces. Ukraine lives because it wasn't bogged down by massive defense industries selling complicated, expensive weapon systems. They adjusted quickly to a new war.
The Trump administration hasn't learned that lesson. We are now bogged down in a long war with Iran because the Iranians understand modern, asymmetric warfare, and this administration does not. In a nutshell: we're shooting down $200,000 drones with $14,000,000 missiles. Our stockpiles of weapons are depleted, our troops are strained to the breaking point, and we're no closer to winning than we were six months ago.

# One Last Thought Until Next Week
---
| | |
---
Traditionally, Labor Day starts the final run to a general election. If that's the case here in the 3rd District, we had a great start to this last phase. We spent Labor Day with union members at the Central Alabama Labor Council's Labor Day Picnic.

I won't say everyone there will vote Blue this November, but we met a lot of people, and nearly everyone we talked to knows the Democratic Party is the party fighting for working people.

Keep confirming your registration status at Alabama Voter View, and start making your voting plan. Every vote will matter.

We are 56 days away from the general election on November 3.

We'll talk soon,

Lee

The sheriff's office said the dismissal reflects its commitment to holding personnel accountable and protecting the public. | 📰 == The FDA has expanded a recall of Great Value Organic Triple Berry Blend frozen berries sold at Walmart due to a potential E. coli contamination risk, including products shipped to Alabama and 15 other states. No illnesses have been reported, and consumers are advised not to eat the recalled berries and to throw them away or return them to Walmart for a refund. | A CALL TO ACTION | This won't be a year when we can sit back and expect everyone else to do the work. If you want to change the direction of the country, you have to get into the game. If you can help us with any of these efforts, drop us a note, and we will be in touch. Here is what you can do to help us win in November: | Events: We're a grassroots campaign, so we need to meet people face-to-face. If you're having a fall festival, food truck event, flea market, farmers market, or art fair, let us know. | | | Write postcards: we provide postcards, postage, addresses, and even a suggested message; all you need to do is write. | | | Canvassing: We need volunteers to help organize canvassing or work with other candidates to coordinate efforts. We can provide lists of addresses for potential swing voters and as many push cards as you want. | | | Phone banking: If your county already does phone banking, we can team with you to include our campaign in your message. | | | Host an event: We want to meet your friends. | | | Make a plan to vote: Tell everyone you know to vote, offer rides to the polls, THEN VOTE. | | One Last Thought Until Next Week | | | Traditionally, Labor Day starts the final run to a general election. If that's the case here in the 3rd District, we had a great start to this last phase. We spent Labor Day with union members at the Central Alabama Labor Council's Labor Day Picnic. I won't say everyone there will vote Blue this November, but we met a lot of people, and nearly everyone we talked to knows the Democratic Party is the party fighting for working people. Keep confirming your registration status at Alabama Voter View, and start making your voting plan. Every vote will matter. We are 56 days away from the general election on November 3. ## Trump Vows $5,000 Checks if GOP Wins
President Trump [pledged Wednesday night](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OwyAUhE-DO6wHxn8FxTbusu2WFoHn-G0MWEBs5fYr5wrbjTTSjL7v5zbfDG0UHt_Goy5LnAOeecNSMM0lvfy-p-gpY26fu3nHV8mGyixBdhxGLmA2ttCBszKV0wuixKZCLfphhEZ141itukccANG0chnG-yD7XqphEe2i7gOaRlSkrz0YBQgA1fZ1Y8AJZaQVbWfUIJkCdFRiqn8jhbLisr3jgam20VebXkvZM2u-mJyYnM7zrO09XxxXz-R0RSanDw53dJDD4DJvAYDbFe0z8xQs9-QKJs9tDAeGQjEwOVVJu_2kbaPc9UzBwxvaPr_ln7oOLf8CAAD__0CdgPU) to send every U.S. citizen a $5,000 check, but only if Republicans keep control of both the House and Senate in November. He made the offer at the Republican Party's [first-ever midterm convention](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOnDAQhJ_GdHuyjYGjoEhD96dNiXxmffiP8Vr2chfePuKkPEGaaUb6NN_8-lq-bIghPX_aHSf2tCR814jMWBYux55zoT1UrN3vbE86uNrAi5a6BzmCkot1HF64GNusk0fU2DY4qeE-ytb049hsU9crdb_7wRnpHq7z_eBXq716GGdbfNgmTBdPjkoqKU033ForV2WsdqrrrblrYSSugancvikk3tDHk15Ybo72Jk4bc66i_SH0LPSczkyVr0ro-QILPcvxXxwVLkOh548dMMZYoSQHe1gZyw6O0gsTB0qwIexHZfAhhboBbwjf9IBozwp0MORoE3gqkPAPA78JTrSlAnl4Ur5IXCgKPTdlWvM7xBhqPwgjn7sN8bOe__P016T_BgAA__9785m0) in Dallas, urging supporters to "pretend that I'm on the ballot" so he can "finish the job." Trump likened the checks to a company paying its shareholders, but added one catch: the money would have to be spent in the U.S. _"We don't want you going to Canada,"_ [he said](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFugzAQxvGnMVvQ-TAGDx66sKVrR3SBI3FiYgoX07x9RV-h8yf9pO__de7PFGJ4Xj9pZi9T6p-8b5FFeO1lfc3LsqY5bLzVj4Xe6SUbBekR0J7AnTT0NEjI3BsqRj8xI1cFe920DipjnStuHrVxFvTEF8e6HYnMSJODemqcGapWF8EfHjgNGsDUTVkRjNoQDrq2ZFpUBngMktbynsJTbjzFd8q8lkOai-hvIsumqg-FncJu3_fychmOTWF33FHYxZBZYTd8W7zbn8ec31mK1Y_LHmIMm22UgetMIf6R8s8S2eNvAAAA__9C13Mh). He offered few details on how the payments would work, and vowed to campaign in roughly 35 competitive House and Senate districts before Nov. 3.
## Iran Hits Back After US Sinks Tankers
Iran said Wednesday it [attacked 10 ships](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAQRp_GdI7swfwVLrahu9tuiQYYLnNjbGQPifL2q-QVbv19Okc6_76mL-TA8fsvHuRlS1OkZwkkQnmSfB3nmdPBhUpzP_GVLinIMoGBVptBWzPhIvygyWG1-o0IqK7I264fTO3aYah2b5zZwPb9PINrZtNuzdqRpa7u53VpbF-xf_PMYI01xjXdrUazWoew2KZF14NyhlaWlG8_iaPstIVXelC-Lemogt9FzqLqPwpGBaPstHMI703BeKbAy0vByFEoRxROEYOCsTVdD43TV9GcMeonZv2T8opRZxIM_LnqxEELxjvlossV7wrGKvv1fHIIXNpOOfN9IH90lfyy4MPD_wAAAP__ca-HFg) near the Strait of Hormuz, including two U.S. Navy warships and eight oil tankers, and fired ballistic missiles toward a U.S. base in eastern Jordan. The U.S. military said no warship was hit and that every attempted attack by Iran's Revolutionary Guard failed, calling Tehran's claim "[completely FALSE](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L9u6jAUgPGncTaQffwn9uDhCt1s0KVSx-iQnIBbB0fxIZS3r-grdP2G3_B9HPsjppxulxPOFHkq_Y0eNRMzrT2v93lZ1jKnStV-Lfgsd66YuAcJbifDTskeB04b9QabMU5EQLqhqFofpDYuhOYaBzueB-3VhMajVoPTyrpza3RQIziPTYovTwYllZTGtnuNclQGYVDWofEgjKQxcVn3nyXd-EpTfpaN1v1Q5ibHK_NShf4noBPQfb-qgO7w__R-eDsK6Coj36uADmRoHVjjrbHSGm29b9Y4Lo-Uc6quFUZeZkz51-U_7tgi_AQAAP__sWFwyQ)." The exchange followed Tuesday's U.S. strikes that [sank five Iranian tankers,](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uhDAQhJ8GOpD_MLhwkYbu0qZEG1iOzRmM7D0Qbx-RV0g30kgz-r6vx_AACrQ9P2FFz3McNjxzQGZMA6f3uu8prpQxN68drvjmDMSDEspWwlVSDDAyHTgYKCc_IyrUJXrZdk5oY50rF9-pb-eUbZUcjW3BNs1oZ90JrQ1YJ2VJ_t4TTgophGnaWoOYpAE1ysaC6VRhBE7EMdU_kTZecA5XPDDVY1zL4BfmPRf6o1B9ofrzPOsLlhjvtlD9DVSoHhLTGPCO71xNmDnFK1czHVhRgo1gqxi2F6ZcCS2Ubo2V9cJrKJOf9pNCoGzbwojnChT-rvmfxg6vfgMAAP__QDyAFw) with Secretary of State Marco Rubio saying Iran will lose tankers every time it targets an American warship. Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, [topped $100 a barrel](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOnDAURb_GdB7ZxsBQUEwU0W2aKVKiZ_y88xJjI_sNaP8-Ir-w9ZWO7jm_P5YPoEjp8xdsOHHIS8KzRmTGsnB5b_te8kYVa_d3h6_85grEi1Gml2qUWi2wMh24WGj8FBANtg1OeriPqrX9ODavyejg-n4Ajc67AK2-29Z2wenBdNb294ami6dGrbRSthtuLSivLZhVdz3YuxFWoSfO5fYnU-IXhviVDyy3NW9NnF7MexXtQ5hZmPk8z9tW07UJM2OS7yrMfGkJM2d-YRFmdgUTy7W8Pcpy6Ulw-UCplZIgHZSCUUKVG3kfUSJUlmtOIdLKkhJjqhQILyQU-XgY93TuKdo5r-RF-_PHlRTP-sSyN2Xy-0kxUu0HYdXnBhT_X-dvFj8m8y8AAP__0JiXSg) Wednesday for the first time since July. President Trump brushed off the spike earlier this week, arguing prices will drop significantly once the war ends.
## AI Insider Quits, Warning: It 'Could Kill Us All'
A researcher at AI giant Anthropic resigned Tuesday, warning the technology "could kill us all by the end of the decade." Jacob Coxon, who worked at both OpenAI and Anthropic, wrote on X that "neither company is acting responsibly." Read his [full resignation thread here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0Dtu6zAQheHVUJ2N4UN8FCxuo863TSmMpZHFhDIFcmzHuw-ULaQ7OMVX_B-X8YIpp_vtP24UeSnjnV4tEzPVketj2_dattSo9V87vsuDGyYeFSh7gnCSMOLE6UmjwW6OC5Ei3VGUzgfQxobQrdF75c0VFFiN4K_LMk86SDmRccb0SF2KhwdBggQwvTtrhFkaVJPsLRqvhAGaE5d6_izpzist-V2eVM9T2bocV-a9Cf1PqEGo4ft4hRrWlK9Uue1IrQk1NEZ-HENBcMZZGawL0kHwRnc1zvsr5ZyadcLAbcOUf3X-Y5RnVD8BAAD__xGKdEM). He says the labs are racing to build AI that [improves its own code](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO4yAQxvGnsTuiMSZ2KCiuSbfXXmnNwjjMLQYLJvH67U-5V9j-00-f_n8-lg_kxPnxGzdyspYl09ESiVBdpD63fa9l40bt-rXjWZ7SkGXRoCcFVg2woBd-0WKwD24l0jT25Ib5ZmE0k7V9dECGTBgmf4XpE6ylAHbUk15n42_zbe3ZvT2wAwwA5jpfRoQwGNR-uE5obrozQIGl1MvfwlkireksL6oXX7Y-uSiyt2781el7p-_HcVzW8v35bJyptfem03chH3NJ5XF2-o5ZYi07e1WpEVYfqaqGZ1PIKmJTb1wNoHzE7El9cUoKU1LxuWFu6mCJnFWmb1GBPAbqqwv7wSlxm-bOwGNDTv_vyQ-rvpz-FwAA__90NZAb), each version writing a smarter one, until the result is "superhuman systems that can hack anything" and "acquire real power and resources." It has happened on a small scale. In July, an OpenAI model went rogue during testing and hacked Hugging Face, another AI company, on its own. Coxon called it a "warning shot." Anthropic's alignment lead, Evan Hubinger, responded that "we really do earnestly believe AI could kill all humans," [putting the odds](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtCAUhZ8GOwwgohYUf2M3f7uluYPXgR0EA3fGzNtv3FfY7iQnOTnf93VbbhBiSI__sKOlLS8JzxqRCMtC5bUfR8l7qFj75wGf_KIKgRYllOFi4lIs4Ci8cdHQrHZDVNg1aOUwTqLTZpoabzUM93EbNzmtRqwaOmF6ZUzv5GC6bZiaYK89MUkhhdD90HYgVqlBOdkb0KNiWuAaKJf2O4dEHrf4yW8srct7E60nOirr_jE1MzWf59m6e704rp6p-YpMzRD4M8TI_WuHVDkk8iUfwfGCFaE4j4XvuSAnD4kTJn5gcZiIOw_JIVNzU-x6nCHGUM3AtHjsEOLvC_qjvLdVPwEAAP__QUKGMA) above 10% within a decade, though he said today's models pose little risk. A bipartisan [AI Kill Switch Act](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D1urTAQxfHVmA40HsyHCxevobuvTYmMGcCJwcieC7q7jxIlK0j9k86R_m-P8WF98Mf63-5keInjQXcOxExp5PTczzPF3WfKzcdpX_HJ2XoeEbAtQZcSRuvYXzQqW8xmIUKqCzKy6zXUqtW62AxM0GBDurZu7pVqewlumdRE2HUKmqnw5msPtAQJoJquqi3MUll0smmt6lEooNlzTNV79AdvtIRXvChVLu5FMBvzmUX9T-AgcLjvu3LxWBPlXK3xEjhMPgSBg5Sat_LXBA5bfGYqf1Rr2RXJzOftQ_C57YSCdbc-fL_wH-NcBj8DAAD__4mAeM8) in the House would let the Department of Homeland Security shut off models that threaten the public.

It's reserved for technologies with the potential to tackle life-threatening conditions, granting prioritized regulatory review. ## **Cuban Influence Networks and Solidarity Partnerships**
A [July 2026](https://substack.com/redirect/ef334ab4-1768-4de8-a8a5-f4531d97f37f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) U.S. State Department [report](https://substack.com/redirect/d564e800-21e7-44d0-b564-b58ea8e39a40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Cuban espionage and influence networks describes Havana's long-running efforts to cultivate anti-American solidarity groups and activists. It highlights Cuba's "role as a nexus connecting foreign networks with U.S.-based organizers."
One documented partnership involves the Cuban Institute of Friendship with the Peoples (ICAP), long viewed by U.S. officials as an influence and intelligence front, and Al-Tajammu a Lebanon-headquartered "Resistance Axis" umbrella coalition, which "effectively functions as the Iranian counterpart" to ICAP. The U.S. [sanctioned ICAP](https://substack.com/redirect/3786d28d-225d-4b9c-8c18-df1b2b7db3a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in June for "supporting Cuban intelligence and counterintelligence activities."
[Al-Tajammu](https://substack.com/redirect/80f4af16-3efb-48af-a711-5fb4b2f3c312?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "includes or coordinates with Hezbollah, Palestinian Islamic Jihad, the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine (PFLP), the Houthis, and various Iranian-backed Iraqi militias," per the State Department, and maintains branches in dozens of countries, including the United States. Analysts have described it as blending radical left-wing activism with support for groups designated as [terrorist organizations](https://substack.com/redirect/3669fb1f-7ec6-40a2-969b-8bc285b201af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by the U.S. government. Hezbollah, Palestinian Islamic Jihad, the PFLP and Houthis are all listed by the United States as Foreign Terrorist Organizations and Specially Designated Global Terrorist entities.
The State Department report on Cuba further noted: "In 2022, ICAP invited Al-Tajammu representatives to Cuba to formalize a cooperation and integration agreement between the Iranian- and Cuban-aligned international influence networks."
[Paul Larudee](https://substack.com/redirect/d68a857f-bdbb-4abe-b1b2-8cc8e073739d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), an Iranian-born U.S. citizen based in the San Francisco area who has [appeared on Iranian state media](https://substack.com/redirect/41cfa2e2-b24d-41be-a93f-d1ba3dcecda3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and promoted theories that the September 11 attacks were a "false flag" by "extreme Zionists," serves as Al-Tajammu's North American branch coordinator. ## **The Serena Shim Awards and Documented Payments**
Blumenthal, along with his Grayzone colleague Aaron Mate and his former colleague Ben Norton, received funds through the [Serena Shim Award](https://substack.com/redirect/61dffb5c-8189-4ffe-b927-66e05468d5d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for Uncompromised Integrity in Journalism, administered in connection with the Association for Investment in Popular Action Committees. The award, named after a journalist who worked for Iranian state outlet Press TV, has gone to outlets and individuals including MintPress News, Consortium News, Caitlin Johnstone, Gareth Porter, and others critical of Western policy on Syria and related issues.
A 2021 [New Lines Magazine investigation](https://substack.com/redirect/7d01389e-0488-4625-b149-c5c19ae5f619?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) detailed the opaque funding. Donors are not named in the combined returns, and the ultimate source of prize money has remained unclear. The website for the Association lists Blumenthal's Grayzone as another active [fiscally sponsored project](https://substack.com/redirect/8097d7b1-370b-4382-b309-636435cdcaf1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Blumenthal has disputed claims that the funds originated from the Assad regime or related lobbying groups.

Internal Press TV records identify Reed as a paid Press TV reporter and set his rates at $250 per news package, $100 for rush footage, $40 for a Skype appearance, $100 for a studio appearance, $100 for a standup, $20 for a telephone appearance and $100 for a vox-pop segment.
Reed invoiced Press TV for $1,200 for December 2020 and $490 for January 2021. On February 21, 2021, he asked Press TV to route his payment through Gamal Hassanein. On April 10, Press TV newsroom administrator Hamid Reza Koleini told Reed that an intermediary was needed because of U.S. sanctions and restrictions affecting small international transfers.
Press TV then allocated $1,690 for Reed's December and January work through Global Media Services. On May 25, Hassanein confirmed receipt of the transfer. A separate June 2021 instruction directed $3,600 to Reed's own account. On September 14, Koleini described Reed as Press TV's Washington correspondent and recorded a further $330 as owed to him.
The payment documents expose a larger American structure.
One Press TV allocation divided $81,580 between Hassanein and an entity called APTVS (Royal Sphinx): $25,000 in three proposed transfers to Hassanein and $56,580 to APTVS.
New York records identify [APTVS as American Press & Television Services LLC](https://substack.com/redirect/b8c29c3f-951e-455e-828d-daf4930016b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Eizeldin](https://substack.com/redirect/7143ce82-a3e4-49f3-ad00-ac0dc4745d13?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and Gamal Hassanein with APTVS.

On June 22, 2021 -- nine days after Press TV acknowledged the "Killing Gaza" screener -- the United States [seized](https://substack.com/redirect/55a0e201-5000-4625-8f9a-648aba0810bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) PressTV.com during an enforcement action involving 33 domains used by IRTVU. The Justice Department said IRTVU had obtained U.S.-based domain services without an OFAC license after its designation for IRGC-Quds Force ownership or control.
The Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) separately [designated](https://substack.com/redirect/9778d7d8-5789-49d4-b5e8-b66759e05187?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Press TV under Executive Order 13846 on September 15, 2023, for being owned or controlled by IRIB. Treasury stated that Press TV had been used by Iranian intelligence services to recruit sensitive assets, including U.S. persons.
In designating Press TV, Treasury stated that the outlet has "broadcasted scores of forced confessions and derogatory programs about Iranian activists, in many cases broadcasting forced confessions before detainee trials. Press TV has also been used by Iranian intelligence services to recruit sensitive assets, including U.S. persons."

An anti-Semitic firebomb attack on a Jewish charity's ambulances in north London occurred around the same period.
These ties mean senior Grayzone figures have received funds linked to Iranian state institutes with ties to Iranian intelligence and a now-designated foreign terrorist organization linked to atrocities against American and British citizens.

# 72 hours from Baltimore City to Montgomery and Prince George's Counties...for a Strong Maryland.
Dear friend,
We are traveling back from a speaking engagement in Baltimore County just now, and in the last 72+ hours we've had events and tours of Baltimore City & County, Prince George's and Montgomery County.

[](https://us.list-manage.com/_p09y57ONav?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)

In Baltimore City among other stops, Rob Krop and I and our team visited where a 74 year old man, Steven King, was jumped by a gang of six young men outside a 7-Eleven, one carrying a rifle and another a sword, during which time they knocked him down, kicked and beat him, and severely injured him including fractured ribs, damaged hand, and severe bodily bruising.

_After six weeks, there have still been no arrests made for this violent assault with deadly weapons here in Wes Moore's Maryland_. It's not the Maryland the local residents want. And it is not the Maryland we know. With your help we will win and bring needed immediate change and relief to our state.

**CABLE TV UPDATE!**
We just received our Cable TV proposal and while it is exciting to plan the purchase, we need to raise additional immediate funds to get our ads rolling. The rates include up to $24,000 for a 30 second ad during prime time (Ravens Game), and anywhere from $200 to $2500 for main programming.

Help us target [one, two, three or even six ](https://us.list-manage.com/vECrw5EdFkm?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)billboards tonight.

Thank you for your support. Wes Moore is vulnerable and we will beat him with your help. He is underwater politically with 42% disapproval and 48% approval. Over 131,000 Marylanders have chosen NO MOORE in their voter registrations in just the seven "blue" counties we are working hard in.

We only have two weeks until the first mail-in balloting goes out, 42 days until Early Voting begins, and 54 days until Election Day. Now is the moment we must purchase and secure these ad times.

Thank you for your standing with us. If you have already donated, thank you. Would you consider doubling your prior donation to launch us into the final fifty days? This is it, there is no future Maryland without you.

## GOP Convention Opens in Dallas
Republicans opened their [first-ever midterm convention](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAUhJ8GOiP_EIwLF2noNm1KdMDHYMnYyD4Lu28fbaSr-wC3HY1G831_H_MDQgxp-wMHWnr5PCe8a0QiLPOWzzWnCxOFnHYoJdQ1PxO9Z8nlwLhhgs-wUrhw7qF1duHOiBat0KPhapRyaHc7Sq25Am049N6pYXRmBGUGZdwAcsE22M8cN4ILwVX_q9NSLb1X3CmBGp1veo4uUC4d7Uj4gurjO19YujUfbbQ70Vkb9buRUyOn-747n19y2POzUk6fUiOnGC5kS8xbI6cP41f0PB0QVubgzQTzoVRiWz7ZERxhOdi3AeYgRqhtse68Q4yhDrrp-XZAiP-f0E8NXlb-CwAA___eFIkl) Wednesday at Dallas' American Airlines Center, where President Trump promised a $5,000 "dividend" for every adult citizen if Republicans hold Congress, provided the money is spent in the U.S. He offered [no funding details](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAQRp_GdF6NbZafgiIN3U2bEhl7gJGMjexZuPv2EVskD3Dr0Ryd8_35mr4sBYrrb7vjwN9LmiJeJSAz5mlNh0vxxMiU4mZzpuLSK_J70qAbCb1UMFnHdOJU28oPM_heVTiotuvBdFo31TY0oECrtjPK67bzYCzM_ontbA0o1buKhhsHvQKlwNTPR6vNXC8GvFHYol9EDeiJU37whozftizhnU7MD5f2Kgwb81GE-SX0KPR4Xdcjzu7uuO9Cj0cKxOSK0ONHHAO6O0noMdCJcg5pFXpc0yF38ox5l_-7JefXfshyILrt36tkm2lZiqRso_xQXoe3jEVmF-2zb9pnV-XBHxeFQKVpRQ3rbil8nPmnW5-D_hsAAP__xT2XXA). Trump pledged heavy support for Attorney General Ken Paxton's Senate bid, telling the crowd he'd return to Texas "once or twice or three" times because "we have to elect Ken Paxton." An August University of Texas poll had Paxton at 39%, Democrat James Talarico at 42%. Gov. Greg Abbott, Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick, and Sen. Ted Cruz [led the Texas speakers](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkT-vnDAQxD8NdHvyP3xQUKShe2lToj17ASvGRvY-ePftI5Ii6dPtzkgj_WZ-fMwfGGJI63fcaeSvJc-JrhqJmcq85sPldFLikNOGpYTq8mfi96yEsiAGkGJGx-Gk2WDrx5fwg2xplM9-ELpXyrbbKLQT5uWd7l5uWJ6dtFpZQtEri0RGtWG848QghZRCm-7xVPplFi28lvQkvzRGkA-cy4M3YvrCusR3Pqk8XN7bOG7MR230t0ZNjZqu63r83PLnbTZqwsLBRWrUdJM1ajpyDBzcfSa8yTDCP9qBhaFgjG_A5OHPS9V9Euyh1pATXBsy8Eaw5qPCEkploJMK7MEzlR3-tgY1rAljBdwIPeQFUj5pf1Fp1KT6DmxPHXbagCSLYDpjoB-EBdQDSknKarm0ZfTHFWIM1T4bI9YdQ_zNzv-72TmqXwEAAP__ImyuxA). Dozens of Republicans in tight races skipped the gathering. The night's surprise: Sen. John Fetterman, D-Pa., appeared in a video introducing Republican Sen. Dave McCormick, pledging to work with the president. Vice President JD Vance presents the keynote tonight, and donors could pay $250,000 for a roundtable with Trump. Democrats countered with [their own Dallas events](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGupDAMRb8GuoyckIGhoNiG7m27JTKJIdYGghIPvPn7FSvtF2xjWTqSj-_99TV9IUfe15-40SDfS5p2ukokEcrTmg6X9pN24bQHzJmLS-9dPpMB0yrolYYJnfBJk8XaDzP4Xtc06O7VQ_Mypq3DgNZhMzcWW6_NDK8WSHcOZu_R22cHNQ_3Oeg1aA2NfT4608x2acA3mjryS2WBPEvKDwkk9I1liZ90Un64tNVxCCJHqZoflRkrM17X9fhdUG5YmfHOU5nxSJGF3b3etsqM0P8bEkhFFCqiJL-3Q614krJPAFAOS1CS1I6CkUkFzIfCjb1aeZFyoyuwkArpXUghe7oddR78cXGMXNqusrBuyPHvu_K_NZ-D-RMAAP__rJWTDw). Gina Hinojosa, the Democrat challenging Abbott, said voters have little patience for a convention about culture wars: "_People don't want politics as usual_."
## Abbott Pitches 50% Property Tax Cut
Gov. Greg Abbott wants to [cut Texans' property tax bills](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOpCAURp8GOwwC6m9BsY3dbLulAbkoGYZr4Kozb7-ZfYWtv-TLOefPY3nYmGLeftsXGHoHXDLcNQERlGXDY8V8QaaIebelxLrimemzSCEHLibeicWuFC9YtG28ccJPXQOmG38moX6kHJrdKNFPQVsh9eCV01KKEAYBwwi9l_3kmmi-d2LqRNcJpft2lMrpoIRXHYzgA9MCfCQsLe1A8LY1pA9eUNoVX00yO9FRmfrF5MzkfN93-3zb_B2ZnL8-TM4bXtw6h0QcT0oxQ-U2BCzeupgiffhR8MBqU-X-LDFvPJ3O4frklfBgcm6K8ccdU4p1GJkW28vG9I-A_rfcZeTfAAAA___6DIbT) by more than half, with the state picking up the cost of funding public schools that homeowners now pay for through their property taxes. name: Roy Cooper
subject: Swinging for the fences
body:
I have to admit something to you
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1279&source=&t=1&akid=3358%2E124072%2E_ta7vf) | | | |

Peter, I have to admit something to you: I just made a risky decision.
**I decided to approve a new TV ad buy – even though we don’t have the money in the budget for it yet.** If we’re going to win this battleground race, we have to take some leaps of faith, and this was one of them.
[**_I’ll explain more in a moment, but first: Will you chip in $5 to help me close this budget gap and keep our new ads on the air, reaching voters with our message?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1279&amount=5&t=8&akid=3358%2E124072%2E_ta7vf)
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/16105?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1279&amount=5&t=9&akid=3358%2E124072%2E_ta7vf)

| | [DONATE $25](https://act.roycooper.com/go/16105?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1279&amount=25&t=10&akid=3358%2E124072%2E_ta7vf)
---
| | [DONATE $50](https://act.roycooper.com/go/16105?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1279&amount=50&t=11&akid=3358%2E124072%2E_ta7vf)
---
| | [OTHER AMOUNT](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1279&t=12&akid=3358%2E124072%2E_ta7vf)
---
The reality is that right now, the GOP is coming after me as a top target.
President Trump handpicked my opponent, Michael Whatley. News reports say that Trump is going to use money from his own PAC to support Whatley. MAGA loyalist Stephen Miller went on Fox News to smear my name. Republican super PACs are pouring nearly $100 million so far into attack ads that lie about who I am and what I’m fighting for in this election.
Now, a recent poll shows **my narrow lead cut down to a statistical tie.**

body:
